description: This file is a React component module for rendering list items in the Notesnook application, including various item types like notes, tags, trash, notebooks, reminders, attachments, and search results. It also contains utility functions for placeholder data and item height calculations.

methods.name: ListItemWrapper
methods.description: React component that renders different types of list items based on the item.type property.

methods.name: getListItemDefaultHeight
methods.description: Calculates the default height of a list item based on its placeholder data.

methods.name: getListItemPlaceholderData
methods.description: Returns placeholder layout data for list items based on group and compact mode.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves a date value for sorting, based on item and group type.
